name: ZETTA Group Co., Ltd.
summary: ZETTA Group Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacturing of spray paints, mechanical and automotive care products, and household care products in China and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Fine Chemicals and Photovoltaic Business. It offers spray paints, such as acrylic, animal marking, benzene-free, custom color, diy wall repair, fluorescent, cold galvanizing, hammer finish, heat resistant, line marker, metallic, second petroleum, trim and bumper, silver zinc rich compound, and water-based spray paints; spray lubricants, including anti-rust lubricant, chain lube, grease spray, mold release, penetrating oil, silicone spray, and white lithium grease.
